title: Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: A kor line-slinger, saved from her fall by Nissa, who guides Jace toward the Singing City while grieving Zareth.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker born on Zendikar who rescues Akiri and merges with the elemental Ashaya to fight Nahiri.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage who reads Nahiri's thoughts, learns her plan and bargains with her, then sides against Nissa for a time.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: An ancient kor lithomancer who seeks the Singing City's focal point to channel the Lithoform Core across Zendikar.

entities.name: Zareth
entities.description: Akiri's friend and love, dead as of this episode.

entities.name: Kaza
entities.description: A member of Akiri's party, sensed by Jace waiting at Sunder Bay.

entities.name: Orah
entities.description: A member of Akiri's party, sensed by Jace waiting at Sunder Bay.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker the Gatewatch must face again.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: A giant antlered elemental of roots and leaves who merges with Nissa in their full power.

entities.name: Moss elementals
entities.description: Smaller elementals in the Singing City.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The titanic beings Nissa and Jace accidentally released and Nahiri trapped.

entities.name: Murasa Skyclave
entities.description: The ruin that reassembles itself after the Core is taken.

entities.name: Sunder Bay
entities.description: The bay below the Skyclave where Akiri's party left their griffins.

entities.name: Singing City
entities.description: A ruined ancient kor city whose humming song drives wanderers mad, and which hides a focal point connected to the leylines.

entities.name: Na Plateau
entities.description: The plateau on the way to the Singing City.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: Nissa's birthplace.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane Jace compares to Nahiri's vision and where he wants to study the Core.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane Nahiri and Nissa fight over.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: The corrupting orb that whispers to Nahiri.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: Zendikar's upheaval that the Core is meant to end.

events.summary: Akiri falls from the Skyclave, remembering Zareth's death, and accepts she will die.
Nissa catches Akiri in a bramble and hauls her onto a ladder of branches.
events.quote: there was a bramble branch curled tightly around her chest

events.summary: Akiri realizes Nissa and Jace are planeswalkers, and learns Nahiri has the Core.
events.quote: I've met Nahiri. She's the one who pushed me.

events.summary: Jace tries a mind attack on Nahiri, who retaliates with a boulder; Akiri saves Jace by swinging them back onto the ladder.
events.quote: Look out!" Akiri shouted, pushing Jace out of the way

events.summary: Nissa senses that Nahiri went north, and Jace reveals he read her mind: she is going to the Singing City.
events.quote: She's going to the Singing City.

events.summary: Nissa goes ahead alone on jurworrell roots, vowing to stop Nahiri and destroy the Core.
events.quote: I will stop Nahiri and destroy the Core,

events.summary: Jace promises to take the Core beyond Zendikar and Akiri agrees to lead him to the Singing City.
events.quote: I'll take you to the entrance of the City so you can help Nissa

events.summary: Jace enters the Singing City and meets Nahiri, who refuses to give up the Core and attacks him.
The city's haunting song nearly drives Jace mad until he casts a silencing spell that also saves Nahiri.
events.quote: A spell that blocked out any sound entering his ears.

events.summary: Nahiri reveals through telepathy that she will channel the Core through the city's focal point, and Jace agrees not to hinder her if she holds off using it until they study it.
events.quote: Runes said there's a magical focal point there that can channel the Core's energy all over Zendikar through the leylines.

events.summary: Nahiri and Jace find the focal point destroyed, and Nissa arrives with Ashaya, claiming the elementals destroyed it.
events.quote: It was," Nissa replied, coldly, "until the elementals destroyed it.

events.summary: Nissa feels betrayed when Jace sides partly with Nahiri; Nahiri hurls swords at Nissa.
events.quote: Nahiri created dozens and dozens of glowing swords.

events.summary: Nissa and Ashaya merge in full power and attack Nahiri, who flees with Jace through the city.
events.quote: The Soul of the Wild seemed to swell with strength, with the drive to protect.

events.summary: Nissa and the elementals, speeding along Zendikar's paths, cut them off at the city gates.
events.quote: Zendikar is where I belong. It's the heart of my power and strength,

events.summary: The elementals surge forward as the battle for Zendikar's soul begins.
events.quote: The battle for Zendikar's soul had begun, and it would be a ruthless fight.

relations.note: Nissa is united with Ashaya, a living embodiment of Zendikar.
relations.quote: I help them, and they help me.

relations.note: Nissa opposes Nahiri's use of the Core.
relations.quote: I refuse to let Nahiri change it into her dead stone vision.

relations.note: Jace came on Nissa's behalf, though he wavers.
Nahiri pushed Akiri to her death.
relations.quote: She's the one who pushed me.

relations.note: Akiri thinks of her friend and love.
relations.quote: She closed her eyes and thought of her friend and love

relations.note: Nahiri trapped the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
relations.quote: Like you were when you trapped the Eldrazi here?
